protocols.name: capability-modularization
protocols.summary: Catalogue functional capabilities, reuse shared foundations, and migrate vertical workflows in verified batches.

protocols.name: protocol-demonstrate
protocols.summary: Turn a requested demonstration into observable requirements, a real user walk, and a reproducible handover.

protocols.name: protocol-document
protocols.summary: Run an explicitly requested documentation sweep: inventory coverage, reverify claims, and fill gaps at their owning source.

protocols.name: protocol-foundry-agent-lifecycle
protocols.summary: Take an agent package to a native Foundry Hosted Agent and through verify, evaluate, optimize, redeploy and re-verify with the template deploy.sh, authoring only the package and pinned caller files.

protocols.name: protocol-garbage-collect
protocols.summary: Prove dead code and abandoned files unreachable in a named area before deleting the authorized set.

protocols.name: protocol-lean
protocols.summary: Survey repository weight across documentation, dependencies, code, CI and infrastructure; measure authorized cleanup.

protocols.name: protocol-regression-loop
protocols.summary: Fix acceptance before editing, validate the actual changed artifact, and repeat focused checks until green or blocked.

protocols.name: protocol-restructure
protocols.summary: Salvage a working legacy area, declare a target shape, migrate reversible batches, and verify before retiring the old tree.

protocols.name: protocol-template-app
protocols.summary: Migrate a customer-specific application into a reusable accelerator, preserving approved public data and workflows while excluding private data, historical state and deployment identity.
